description: 35a: Strict 3-cal binding prediction with α_(k>=4) = m_e·8G (universal Term 7 only) and α_0..α_3 = 0. Tests how much of binding comes from the Term 7 shell-correction prefactor alone — the only universal prefactor allowed under strict 3-cal (m_e, q_0, m_p).

structural_alpha_k.note: α_(k>=4) = m_e · 8G (universal Term 7 prefactor per prop:plancherel-term-7-formulation). α_0..α_3 set to zero — captures ONLY the shell correction.

predictions.note: trivially zero (no k>=4 partitions at H_3)

pattern.observation: Term 7 capture fraction grows with A — D 6%, T 10%, ³He 11%, ⁴He 25%. Magic ⁴He has largest Term 7 contribution, consistent with shell-correction interpretation.
pattern.implication: α_0..α_3 cannot be zero structurally. Volume, surface, Coulomb, Pauli sectors per skein-binding-lagrangian.md need their own structural derivation from (m_e, q_0) alone — this is the open project.

verdict_strict_3cal_predictive_power.single_nucleon_works: n predicted at -0.19% from p; Q_β/Δm at ppb-class via fitted ladder
verdict_strict_3cal_predictive_power.shell_correction_works: Term 7 with universal m_e·8G captures 25% of B(⁴He)
verdict_strict_3cal_predictive_power.multi_nucleon_binding_open: Volume + surface + Coul + Pauli sectors need 3-cal derivation; without them, strict 3-cal predicts only the Term 7 shell fraction (6-25% of total binding)

next_structural_project: Derive λ_V, λ_S, λ_C, λ_Pauli, λ_pair (BW-Lagrangian prefactors) from m_e, q_0 alone — categorical analog of nuclear semi-empirical formula.
Verify that the resulting Σ α_k Φ_k closes binding to <10% across light isotopes.
